about.title: About
about.description: Danny Jenkins and Jenkins Detailing: a CarPro approved detailing centre at Rose Garage, Tregaron, since 2013.
about.story:
Danny started detailing at seventeen with his own first car. Three years in catering and hospitality followed, working as a second chef alongside Will Holland and Angela Gray, before the cars won. In 2013 he founded Jenkins Detailing.

What started with basic washes has become a detailing centre that draws clients from across Wales and from London and Manchester. The unit at Rose Garage in Tregaron has a dedicated 4000 kg lift for undersealing and is a CarPro approved detailing centre. Danny and the team also work at the door.

Rose Garage itself has been in the family since 1915, the longest established garage in Ceredigion.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: How Jenkins Detailing handles the personal data you send through this site.
privacy.body:
This site collects only what you send through the quote form or by email: your name, contact details, the vehicle and your message. We use it to reply to you and to carry out the work you ask for. We do not sell it or share it with anyone except the services that deliver our email.

The site sets no tracking cookies. If you choose the 3D or Plain view, a preference cookie called jd-view remembers that choice for one year. Traffic is measured with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which does not use cookies or identify individuals.

You can ask what we hold about you, or ask us to delete it, by emailing us. We keep quote requests for twelve months unless you become a customer, in which case we keep the job record for our accounts.

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: The terms on which Jenkins Detailing carries out work.
terms.body:
Quotes are given after we have seen the vehicle, in person or from photographs, and may change if its condition differs from what was described.

Paint correction removes defects from the clear coat; it cannot remove damage that has gone through it. We measure paint depth before we start and will tell you where correction is not safe.

Coatings and undersealing carry the guarantees stated on the service page, which depend on the maintenance programme being followed.

Vehicles are left with us at the owner's risk but are kept in a locked unit and insured while in our care. We ask for payment on collection.
